mechanism: Only replace disturbance desired target: (z_k-z_prev)/(t_k-t_prev) minus mean of stored pre-correction g=drive_a-resistance(v) over exactly [t_prev,t_k]. No wheel regression, new tau, actuator integration, readout change, covariance observer or H11 quarantine.
reconstruction: Piecewise-linear interpolation of original pre-correction g snapshots at output ticks; integrate analytic overlaps of those segments, never extrapolate. Snapshots are available by the current output timestamp; no future inputs or waiting. This is exact for affine g snapshots, approximate for nonlinear/inter-step g. Do not change numerical prediction.
skip_policy: If any part of [t_prev,t_k] is uncovered or invalid, skip this disturbance update without replacing g or falling back to endpoint. Preserve original adapt_previous bookkeeping and all unrelated guards. Record a bounded last diagnostic and fixed-name counters. No repeated measurement assimilation.
tuning: None. All physics, bounds, adaptation tau and reconstruction settings fixed before experiments. Baseline is not a candidate.
controls: canonical v7 with feature off, exact returned Estimate and old-state equivalence
non-selectable development-only skip-control: same history/eligibility checks, original endpoint desired target; quantifies whether skipping alone explains an apparent effect
prior_art: Read v6 negative projection/decay report; H03 PR20 smoothness/fault failure; H04 PR19 variable-tau failure; H10 PR18 joint covariance failure; PR14 guarded readout and PR23 low-speed guard are the baseline. PR26 H11 read as adjacent work, not included. No other R2 agent validation is consulted.

data_roles.train: All 64 original train bags via Store.load(train); three vehicle topics only, no GNSS; implementation activation/causality diagnostics, no accuracy claim or fitting.
data_roles.development: All 17 original development bags from unchanged split_v3.json. Isolated read-only loader checks role and DB SHA before IO; unchanged decode/scales/order. Reference only to external score. Never alias development to validation or train.
data_roles.validation: Only original 19 validation bags, exactly one frozen paired run if prevalidation coverage/safety permits. No changes afterwards.
data_roles.test: Do not extract or open final/test DB payloads, load test reference, or read historical final results. Dataset archive can be checksum-verified, then extract only explicitly allowed roles.

coverage_before_validation.transition_definition: command sign-class traction/coast/brake changes; use deadband and causal held controller, no reference
coverage_before_validation.mechanism_decision: If insufficient coverage, INCONCLUSIVE and no validation. If sanity or added safety failures, REJECTED and no validation. Train/development smoothness cannot replace accuracy.

development_decision: One candidate only; measure accuracy including original outages, transitions and skip-control. No minimum gain required to spend validation, but all safety/coverage checks and activation thresholds must pass. Freeze even when development accuracy suggests likely rejection, provided safety passes. No tuning after inspecting development.
original_suite: Import unchanged tools/research_guarded/compare.py fault_windows and tools/finalization/evaluate.py score/replay/matching. New isolated factory maps baseline_v2 and balanced_physics to canonical v7 and candidate, names do not select legacy v5. Original anchors, bias +5m/s 5s, dropout 5s/10s, lock 3s, warmup and recovery windows remain exact. Aggregation from unchanged tools/research_v6/compare.py summary.

diagnostics.development: All original suites plus phase-conditioned existing outputs, low-speed lock (first valid 1<v<2 vehicle grid after 25s and before duration-25, duration3s), and transition dropout (first command class transition at v>2 after25s and before duration-25, duration5s), one deterministic anchor per bag/suite. Separate from admission metrics.
diagnostics.validation: Original suite only; collect traces of existing runs, not extra candidate selection. Save original/new d_target, measured_a, current pre/post-correction g, interval mean(g), reason, d before/during/after fault and output v error matched externally. Detailed faults plus bounded clean diagnostics.
diagnostics.ablation: Off baseline and development-only identical-skip endpoint control, never selectable. If improvement exists only through skipping and not interval target, mechanism is not supported.

acceptance.zero_baseline_guard: For nonnegative aggregate baseline=0 permit candidate <=1e-12 absolute, report absolute delta and no relative gain; never divide by zero. Missing reference is null not zero.

runtime_checks: Feature-off exact equality; constant g; affine interval integration and age-bias identity; overlapping fractional segments; invalid/stale/clipped/gap/reset; prefix causality; held/duplicate/future/nonfinite input; max32 segments and .75s horizon; no NaN; guard AST checks; entire legacy tests without removing historical guards.
cost: Same complete first lexicographic development bag after one unmeasured warmup; four AB/BA pairs, alternating order, fixed OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, identical output collection. Record wall/CPU per replay and outputs, no ROS latency claim. Separate short step CPU benchmark. If accuracy passes, installed enabled H13 offline ROS both clock modes real development replay under2CPU/500000000B required; otherwise explicitly not performed.
freeze: Separate published commit containing candidate/driver/evaluator/profile/split/plan/DB hashes and development eligibility, before any validation IO. Source SHA separate from freeze/report commit. Verify hashes and commit barrier on validation start.
commands: git add OUT/FREEZE.json && git commit && git push (only this research's unique checkpoint branch)
output: reports/research_R2/H13/<run-id>/; raw JSON/CSV, per-bag/receiver/fault, access journals, freeze/PLAN, source patch, tests/logs, sources with read-level, Wolfram worksheet+actual output. New immutable checkpoint per run/attempt, no raw bags or secrets committed.
verdict: CONFIRMED only if R2 numerical contract and required runtime checks pass. Measured contract failure REJECTED for this candidate. Missing execution/coverage INCONCLUSIVE. Mechanism status and merge readiness separate. Draft PR in Russian; no merge/auto-merge.
